fixes.title: Subnautica Below Zero + Multiplayer (BOT Benson)
fixes.description: Launch the game itself instead of the mod's launcher. Subnautica.Multiplayer.exe never reaches the game on Linux: it dies on OnlineFix's self-protection, and even with OnlineFix kept out of it, it refuses to run and asks you to re-download the mod. The mod does not need that launcher — the game loads it from %AppData%\.botbenson on its own, once the patched Assembly-CSharp.dll is in place. This fix points the launcher at SubnauticaZero.exe and passes the identity the mod would otherwise have taken from the launcher's account and VPN.

fixes.title: Subnautica + Nitrox (multiplayer)
fixes.description: Get Nitrox to load properly. The mod doesn't load via DLL proxy; instead, it uses NitroxPatcher and the mod's own launcher—a .NET 9 application. Without the runtime present in the prefix, it won't start, and the game launches in its vanilla state. This fix installs the .NET Desktop Runtime 9 into the prefix and configures the launch sequence to use the Nitrox launcher.
